description: Complete observability dashboard for one LSR service running under RoadRunner. The service name is configured during import and is used consistently as Prometheus/Loki label service_name and Jaeger service name. LSR metric panels accept default suffix-enabled and suffix-free OpenTelemetry Prometheus translation. Native RoadRunner panels require the metrics plugin, http_metrics middleware, Jobs plugin, and a service_name scrape label.
